custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have three inactive parts, part A, part B and part C.
  • Give parts A, B and C part numbers that start with the same text, so one search lists all three.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Inactive tab.

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • To create a part: click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill Description and Part Number (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425606-A for part A, -B for part B), pick a Category, type a Cost and a Sell Price, type the Quantity in the bin row (the location's bin, for example General Storage, is offered), then click Save. Leave Track quantities and cost of goods on for a tracked part; click it off for an untracked part. Add Bin Location adds a second bin; Vendor, Manufacturer, Core Charge, Min, Max and Tags are in the same window. Parts that must start with the same text all start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425606-, so searching for that finds them all.
  • The Search box above the Inventory list opens when you click Search (the magnifier).
  • To set a part inactive: on the Inventory page's Active tab click Search, type its part number, click its row; in Edit Inventory Part click Inactive under Part Status, click Save, then click Deactivate in the Deactivate part? window. The part then shows on the Inactive tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Parts A, B and C are listed, with no checkbox column.

Step 2:

  • With bulk mode off, the row click opens Edit Inventory Part for part A.

Step 3:

  • The window closes without changes.

Step 4:

  • The menu opens.

Step 5:

  • The checkbox column and the dark bar appear; the bar reads 0 selected, with a blue "Activate" button.

Step 6:

  • The part A row is ticked (1 selected) and no window opens.

Step 7:

  • The part A row is unticked (0 selected).

Step 8:

  • All 3 loaded rows are ticked (3 selected).

Step 9:

  • All ticks are cleared (0 selected).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10816 (Story 3, Activate Parts in Bulk), story SV-10815 (Story 2, Deactivate Parts in Bulk)

  • S3-R3: “S2-R3 to S2-R10b, S2-R14 to S2-R17 and S2-N3 apply on the Inactive tab exactly as on the Active tab, with "deactivate" read as "activate". The disabled button's hover text is "Tick the parts to activate".”
  • S2-R3: “Outside the mode the Inventory list has no checkbox column, and a row click opens the part.”
  • S2-R5: “While the mode is on, a click anywhere on a row ticks or unticks that row instead of opening the part.”
  • S2-R6: “The checkbox in the header ticks or clears every row loaded in the list. The list loads 30 parts at a time as the user scrolls, so it ticks only the rows loaded so far. The count in the bar shows exactly how many parts will change.”

Last checked against build v26.43.4-999c51d (QA site sv10647) on 11/3/2026.
